note: v486: Every part of the app is now optional. Settings → Sections gets a new switch for Jobs & Calendar, so the calendar and event reminders turn off like any other tab. Switching a section off now also stops what it was doing in the background: no reminders or bell notifications for a section you turned off, and no recurring invoices or expenses quietly piling up where you can't see them (they catch up the moment you turn it back on). Invoice Defaults and Expense Categories drop out of Settings when you don't use those sections, and if you switch everything off, the Home screen tells you where to turn things back on instead of going blank.
